description: A criterion keeps citing a finding the plan marks closed. A limit that has gone is a level to raise, not a citation to keep; the report would otherwise understate the library on the day it improved. The case carries BOTH halves of its own defect — the citation and the closing — and the evidence beside the finding is copied here rather than borrowed, because point 5 rules on the level before point 6 sees the finding and a criterion left with nothing but a citation fires the wrong check. Until 2026-09-16 the case named whichever finding a row leaned on today, and it had moved three times for that reason (4.8, then 4.37 on the night 4.37 closed, then 4.45). The fourth time it did not move: 2.2 closed, nothing cited it, and the control passed while proving nothing (`lesson-216`).
